worker_claim.report: The implementation preserves frozen-plan validation and exact completion accounting, including skipped and failed semantic leaves. Python compilation, diff checks, and direct reporter smoke validation passed; the environment does not provide pytest.
worker_claim.summary: Implemented stream-aware semantic progress rendering with a compact rewriting TTY bar and preserved deterministic non-TTY START/DONE/SKIP/FAILED output. Added durable per-invocation build evidence logs, concise TTY success/failure results, diagnostic suppression for interactive runs, and focused TTY regression coverage.
